entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: A prophet from Femeref who led that nation during the Mirage Wars of Dominaria and was slain freeing Mangara.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A nation of Jamuraa governed by a theocracy and the Council of Voices, with its capital at Tulumai.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the Mirage Wars took place.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The continent of Dominaria threatened by Kaervek.

entities.name: Mirage Wars
entities.description: The war on Dominaria during which Asmira led Femeref.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A mage who brokered peace between Femeref, Zhalfir and Suq'Ata and was later imprisoned in an Amber Prison by Kaervek.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A villain from Urborg who moved against Jamuraa and summoned the Spirit of the Night.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A nation of Jamuraa with a royal court at Ki'pamu.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A nation of Jamuraa that Mangara helped broker peace with.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: The place with a royal court where Asmira moved.

entities.name: Tulumai
entities.description: The capital of Femeref, seat of the Council of Voices.

entities.name: Council of Voices
entities.description: The head of government of Femeref, slaughtered by the Spirit of the Night.

entities.name: Spirit of the Night
entities.description: A monster Kaervek summoned from Urborg to kill the Council of Voices.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who aided the people of Jamuraa with visions. Planeswalker.

entities.name: Mwonvuli
entities.description: The place from which Asmira led an expedition to recover Mangara.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: The prison in which Kaervek imprisoned Mangara.

entities.name: Purraj of Urborg
entities.description: Kaervek's right hand, who slew Asmira.

events.summary: Asmira sees an early harvest as an omen of war and warns Femeref's theocracy, but few believe her.
events.quote: Asmira saw this as an omen of war and warned the theocracy of Femeref, but there were but few who believed her.

events.summary: Kaervek summons the Spirit of the Night, which slaughters the Council of Voices in Tulumai; Asmira is propelled to power.
events.quote: When the people of Femeref discovered the monster had slaughtered the council, they realized Asmira had been right all along and she was immediately propelled to power as their successor.

events.summary: Asmira is appointed Sidar of the Femeref armies and leads them against Kaervek's forces.
events.quote: Asmira was appointed Sidar, Zhalfirin for general, of the Femeref armies.

events.summary: Teferi sends visions to Jamuraa, and Asmira leads the expedition to recover the imprisoned Mangara.
events.quote: She led the expedition to recover Mangara, whom Kaervek had imprisoned in an Amber Prison , from the Mwonvuli .

events.summary: Purraj of Urborg slays Asmira while she frees Mangara; she is named the Holy Avenger posthumously.
events.quote: She was given the posthumous title of Holy Avenger for her brave sacrifice.

relations.note: Became leader of the nation after the Council of Voices was slain.
relations.quote: was a prophet from Femeref and the leader of that nation during the Mirage Wars of Dominaria .

relations.note: Slew her while she freed Mangara.
relations.quote: Although Kaervek's right hand, Purraj of Urborg , slew her while she was freeing the imprisoned mage
